**Role:** Digital Marketing Consultant, Cal Poly Pomona paid micro internship (two person team)\
**Timeline:** Aug 2025 to May 2026

## The challenge

Wellness Ranch offers equine assisted therapy. The work showed that the real bottleneck wasn't finding clients, it was finding donors to fund the service.

## What I delivered

- A digital marketing strategy with market segmentation, a SWOT analysis, and integrated channel recommendations
- A brand positioning framework built around the person to person nature of the therapy
- A segmented email strategy for donors, current clients, and prospective clients
- SEMrush SEO work: keyword research, on page recommendations, and tracking
- A client presentation with a phased action plan

## Key numbers from the SEO audit

| Measure | Finding |
|:--|:--|
| Site health | 87%, with 0 critical errors |
| Mobile vs. desktop performance | 65 vs. 92 |
| Homepage word count | 169 vs. about 920 for competitors |
| Images missing alt text | 25 of 97 |
